Copas 1.1.0

A major release introducing seamless clipboard history synchronization across all your Macs using private iCloud and CloudKit.

  • CloudKit Synchronization: Sync your clipboard history across your Macs securely. Clips—including rich text, large text, and images—are synchronized automatically across devices signed into the same Apple ID.
  • Private by Design & Opt-In: Sync is completely opt-in and disabled by default. Your data is stored solely in your private CloudKit database with no external servers, accounts, or analytics.
  • Instant Remote Push Updates: Changes made on one Mac appear almost instantaneously on other Macs through CloudKit database subscriptions and background notifications.
  • Smart Conflict Resolution & Deletions: Seamless newest-wins conflict resolution and cross-device deletion tracking keep your history in lockstep without duplicate cards.
  • Dedicated Sync Settings: A new Sync tab in Settings allows you to easily toggle synchronization, view your iCloud connection status, inspect pending uploads, and trigger manual syncs on demand.

Your existing local clips, pinned items, and settings are preserved seamlessly.

Copas 1.0.12

A focused release bringing media canvas drag-and-drop support for photo and graphic editors, improved copy button interaction and persistence, and automated release signing stability.

  • Drag & Drop to Media Canvases (Photoshop, Figma, Pixelmator): Image clips can now be dragged directly onto image canvases, creative tools, and graphic editors without drag gesture conflicts or invalid metadata rejections.
  • Copy Button Reaction & Window Persistence: Clicking the Copy button in the detail view now triggers immediate HUD feedback and leaves the clipboard board open for uninterrupted workflow rather than unexpectedly closing.
  • Sparkle Automation Stability: Headless release pipeline improvements ensuring automated appcast signing and publication without keychain modal lockups.

Your existing clips, settings, and database are preserved seamlessly.

Copas 1.0.11

A stability, drag-and-drop, and Apple Intelligence refinement release resolving external image dragging, Writing Tools regeneration locks, text selection affordance dismissal, and dynamic cursor-following capture feedback.

  • Native Image Drag & Drop to Finder and Outside Apps: Image clips can now be dragged directly out of the clipboard list or detail preview into Finder folders, Desktop, Mail compose windows, Slack, Discord, web browsers, and any application expecting a native file URL.
  • Writing Tools Regeneration Stability: Fixed an issue where regenerating text with Apple Intelligence Writing Tools on macOS 15+ could freeze the text editor. Synchronized Writing Tools lifecycle events cleanly to protect editor state and prevent animation deadlocks.
  • Apple Intelligence & Siri Affordance Focus Handling: Selecting text in the editor and clicking the inline Apple Intelligence / Siri icon or context menu no longer inadvertently dismisses the clipboard panel.
  • Contextual "Text Copied" HUD: The capture completion pill and progress toasts now appear anchored right next to the selected screen region or mouse cursor on the active display, rather than fixed at the bottom of the primary monitor.
  • Instant Copy Feedback: Clicking the Copy button in the detail pane now provides immediate visual confirmation with a checkmark badge.

Your existing clips, settings, and database are preserved seamlessly.
